base_target.note: Anchor years confirmed by several sources; years between are interpolated linearly.

direct_target.note: Anchor years; years between are interpolated linearly.

interpolation.note: Matches the draft's year-by-year table as understood (e.g. 2029: 6%/19%, 2031: 12.4%/25.4%); confirm against the official MARPOL Annex VI text.

direct_target_after_2035.note: Not yet set by IMO. Assumes the 13-point gap of 2035 is kept to 2040 and both targets reach 100% by 2050.

base_target_after_2040.note: Not yet set by IMO; assumes net zero by 2050.

ru_price_usd.note: Initial prices for reporting periods 2028–2030 (USD per t CO2e).

ru_price_after_2030.note: The price mechanism from 2031 is to be set by 1 January 2028; prices are held constant in nominal terms.

surplus_unit_value_usd.note: Conservative: surplus units earn nothing unless sold. Varied in the uncertainty analysis.

gwp100.note: IMO LCA guidelines' default factors are pending; FuelEU default fuel factors are used with AR5 GWPs.

excludes_domestic.note: Ships trading solely domestically are excluded.

scenarios.note: Adoption vote due 4 December 2026. 'Delayed' shifts the start by one year with the same calendar targets.
